## About
Team Electric is a family-owned electrical contractor based on Lipan St. in Denver. We serve the entire Denver metro area, with limited service across the rest of Colorado.
Nathan Rons, our President, has worked on design builds, remodels, ground-ups, schools, office buildings, retail stores, art galleries, health care and industrial facilities, and he knows restaurant construction and remodels especially well. Duane Rons, our Chief Operation Officer, has done electrical work for everything from fast food spots to elegant restaurants, banks, theaters, hospitals and high-rise buildings.
We hold a 5 star Google rating from 22 reviews, and we'd welcome the chance to become your preferred electrical contractor.

## Services
- Restaurant construction and remodels: Buildouts, remodels and tenant changes for restaurant spaces. One reviewer said we stayed with them every step of the way.
- Commercial electrical: Electrical work for retail stores, restaurants, hotels and offices.
- New construction electrical: Wiring for new commercial buildings and offices.
- Industrial production equipment: Power for production equipment and other large projects. One reviewer had us set up a large CNC in their woodshop.
- Specialized commercial and industrial equipment: We work on trip units and breaker equipment such as Amptector, Power Shield, Versa Trip, Selectrip and Opti-Trip.
- Data cabling: Data cabling for commercial spaces.

## FAQ
Q: What area do you serve?
A: We serve the entire Denver metro area, with limited service to the rest of Colorado.

Q: Do you work with hotels?
A: Yes. One reviewer has called us at every hotel they've worked at.

Q: Who runs Team Electric?
A: Nathan Rons is our President, and Duane Rons is our Chief Operation Officer.
